title: REQ · A held lock blocks Run and exceeded budget stops retries with ErrBudgetExceeded
summary: Lock-held and budget-stop behavior are confirmed and proven
description: Context: run acquires lock.Acquire before any state is written, and stops retrying once spent > MaxBudget. Desired: both are proven including that a held lock creates no worktree and no execution record, and that a budget stop persists FAILED and removes the worktree once. Why: protects the single-run-per-World guarantee and spend cap.
acceptance_criteria: Given the lock file exists, When Run is called, Then errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked), agent.calls is 0, no worktree is created and store.Get(EXEC-1) fails
Given cost 3.0, MaxBudget 5.0, MaxRetries 5 and all calls fail, When Run is called, Then the error wraps ErrBudgetExceeded, agent.calls is 2, stored status is FAILED and trees.removed has one entry

in_scope: Confirm lock acquisition order and budget condition in runner.go

definition_of_done: Lock-before-save order and budget condition verified correct
